e.title: Insurance Contract Gap/Overlap Benchmark
e.summary: 寿险保单文档 Gap/Overlap 分析基准：本体 + 胜任力问题 + 关键短语抽取（契约 NLP）
e.body: Gap & Overlap Analysis Insurance Contract Benchmark（brains-group）是寿险保单文档分析的评测基准：保单契约语料、本体（TBox/ABox）、胜任力问题（competency questions）套件与关键短语抽取代码——评估 LLM/NLP 在保单条款 gap/overlap 分析上的表现。对 RIAA：保单契约理解（contract understanding）的稀缺基准——条款间矛盾/缺口/重叠是合规与产品设计的核心关注；与 [[clauseguard]]（条款审查）、[[finclaw]]（法律文档 AI）、[[ins-actbench]]（领域评测）构成契约 NLP 评测谱系；保险 NLP 研究的评测靶场。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：README 确认（寿险保单 gap/overlap 评测基准 + 本体 + 胜任力问题），未实测
e.summary_en: Life-insurance policy-document gap/overlap analysis benchmark: ontology + competency questions + keyphrase extraction (contract NLP)
e.summary_hk: 壽險保單文檔 Gap/Overlap 分析基準：本體 + 勝任力問題 + 關鍵短語抽取（契約 NLP）
e.body_en: The Gap & Overlap Analysis Insurance Contract Benchmark (brains-group) is an evaluation benchmark for life-insurance policy-document analysis: contract corpus, ontology (TBox/ABox), a competency-question suite and keyphrase-extraction code — assessing LLM/NLP performance on gap/overlap analysis of policy clauses. For RIAA: a rare benchmark for policy-contract understanding — clause contradictions/gaps/overlaps are core concerns in compliance and product design; with [[clauseguard]] (clause review), [[finclaw]] (legal-document AI) and [[ins-actbench]] (domain evaluation) it forms the contract-NLP evaluation lineage; an evaluation ground for insurance-NLP research.
e.body_hk: Gap & Overlap Analysis Insurance Contract Benchmark（brains-group）是壽險保單文檔分析的評測基準：保單契約語料、本體（TBox/ABox）、勝任力問題（competency questions）套件與關鍵短語抽取代碼——評估 LLM/NLP 在保單條款 gap/overlap 分析上的表現。對 RIAA：保單契約理解（contract understanding）的稀缺基準——條款間矛盾/缺口/重疊是合規與產品設計的核心關注；與 [[clauseguard]]（條款審查）、[[finclaw]]（法律文檔 AI）、[[ins-actbench]]（領域評測）構成契約 NLP 評測譜系；保險 NLP 研究的評測靶場。
